summary: RechargeMate is a mobile application designed to simplify the process of recharging prepaid mobile accounts, providing a seamless, secure, and user-friendly experience. It integrates multiple payment gateways and offers a wide range of recharge options to become the go-to solution for mobile users requiring quick and reliable recharge services.

user_stories.title: User Registration via Mobile Number
user_stories.i_want_to: register using my mobile number and authenticate via OTP
user_stories.so_that: I can securely access the app
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when they enter their mobile number, then they should receive an OTP for verification.
Given a user with a valid OTP, when they enter it, then they should be successfully registered and logged in.

user_stories.title: Social Media Login
user_stories.i_want_to: log in using my Google or Facebook account
user_stories.so_that: I can access the app without creating a new account
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they choose to log in with Google, then they should be redirected to Google's authentication page and logged in upon successful authentication.
Given a user, when they choose to log in with Facebook, then they should be redirected to Facebook's authentication page and logged in upon successful authentication.

user_stories.title: Recharge Mobile Number
user_stories.i_want_to: recharge my mobile number by selecting my telecom operator and choosing a recharge amount
user_stories.so_that: I can top-up my mobile credits
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they select a telecom operator, then they should see available plans and offers.
Given a user, when they enter their mobile number and select a recharge amount, then they should be able to proceed to payment.

user_stories.title: Integrate Multiple Payment Gateways
user_stories.i_want_to: use different payment gateways like PayPal, Stripe, and local banks
user_stories.so_that: I can securely complete my transactions
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they proceed to payment, then they should see options for PayPal, Stripe, and local banks.
Given a user, when they select a payment gateway, then they should be able to complete the transaction securely.
Given a user, when they complete a transaction, then they should have the option to save their payment details for future use.

user_stories.title: View Transaction History
user_stories.so_that: I can keep track of my recharge activities
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they navigate to the transaction history, then they should see a list of past transactions with details such as date, amount, and status.
Given a user, when they view a transaction, then they should see detailed information about that transaction.

user_stories.title: Support Multiple Languages
user_stories.i_want_to: use the app in my preferred language
user_stories.so_that: I can have a better user experience
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they set their language preference, then the app should display content in English, Spanish, or Mandarin based on their choice.
Given a user, when they change their language preference, then the app should immediately reflect the change in language.

user_stories.title: Receive Push Notifications
user_stories.i_want_to: receive notifications for successful recharges, failed transactions, and promotional offers
user_stories.so_that: I can stay informed about my account activities
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when a recharge is successful, then they should receive a notification confirming the success.
Given a user, when a transaction fails, then they should receive a notification with the failure reason.
Given a user, when there are promotional offers, then they should receive notifications about these offers.
